verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax docs show nexus monitoring/identification of where registration may be needed based on past transactions (docs-7, docs-17) and registration support (docs-14, docs-18), plus US filing automation via TaxJar (docs-10), but there is no evidence of voluntary disclosure agreement support or back-filing/remediation for prior periods where tax should have been collected. Community feedback even notes users must handle filing and remittance themselves (stripe-tax-comm-5), reinforcing the gap.
